summary: Backend-only testing of export deduplication and cleanup-duplicates endpoint. All 5 tests passed. Verified: (1) 4 identical loans in Sep-2026 are all persisted in DB (distinct IDs), (2) Month export GET /api/backup/export-month/Sep-2026 returns Excel with only 1 row for the duplicate customer, (3) POST /api/loans/cleanup-duplicates as admin returns duplicates_removed>=3 and leaves exactly 1 remaining in DB, (4) Same customer/contact/bank/company but different status (Pending vs Approved) are NOT deduped -- both appear in export, (5) Full export via GET /api/export/loans dedupes duplicates as well.
critical_code_review_comments: Month export dedup key uses 7 fields (excludes group_month) while cleanup-duplicates uses 8 fields (includes group_month). This inconsistency is intentional per the design (month export is already month-scoped), but worth documenting.

sanction/disbursed are stored as strings in the schema (POST /api/loans requires string) — numeric comparison for dedup relies on exact string match; '100000' vs '100000.0' would not dedupe. Consider normalizing numerically.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary loans with customer_name='TEST_DEDUP_CUST' (4 identical) and 'TEST_DEDUP_DIFFSTATUS' (2 with different status) in Sep-2026. All cleaned up post-test via module fixture. Verified 0 TEST_DEDUP loans remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full export path is /api/export/loans (NOT /api/backup/export). Month export path is /api/backup/export-month/{month_key}. Loan sanction/disbursed fields must be strings in POST /api/loans (Pydantic validation). Cleanup fixture in test_export_dedup.py scans all loans matching TEST_DEDUP prefix and removes them.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verified working as designed.
